lore_anchors.definition: A nearly-immortal-grade ginseng said to move through earth like a living creature; each ‘turn’ marks a stage of magical maturation.
A thousand-year-old ghost who sacrificed his physical form and reincarnation for vengeance; exists as a Profound Soul Body.
The Nascent Soul founder of Extreme Yin Island; a demonic-path elder of the Chaotic Star Sea.
A hedonistic, mid-level demonic overlord of the Chaotic Star Sea; loud, arrogant, and openly contemptuous.
The cold, calculating Sect Leader of the Ten Thousand Laws Sect; delivers lethal threats as casual remarks.
A legendary fruit that can extend the consumer’s lifespan; guarded by a powerful mountain spirit in this space.
One of two routes in the second trial; a bone-piercing cold path where a single misstep freezes the body solid.
The other route in the second trial; a blistering heat path that can turn a cultivator to ash without warning.
A spirit bird mentioned by the Profound Bone Saint; chasing it across an improbable distance led him to the Nine-Turn Spirit Ginseng.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Nine-Turn Spirit Ginseng choose a barren mountain with no spiritual energy?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, the most valuable treasures often hide in the most unassuming places to avoid detection; a peak thick with qi is exactly where greedy cultivators look first, so a truly intelligent ginseng picks the spot no one bothers to check.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why do the Nascent Soul cultivators all separate immediately after arriving?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Each of them has a secret agenda and zero intention of sharing resources or exposing their trump cards in front of rivals; the polite excuses are a social ritual that everyone recognizes as a lie.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is significant about the Profound Bone Saint’s blood-red eyes?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Chinese folk and demonic imagery, red eyes signal a ghost, corpse mutilation, or a being that has abandoned human nature; combined with his Profound Soul Body, it confirms he is no longer a living cultivator but a walking grudge.
